system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: System prompts, created by the developer, lay out the overall scenario for the agent.
system_prompt_style.note: Per-role system prompts passed as strings (agent.py system_prompt arg); prompt source files not in evidence.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: The researcher can access program outputs with the toolsview_imagesand view_text_files, by specifying a list of files it wants to see.
env_context_strategy.note: Task prompt describes dataset; agent reads files via tools.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Files are truncated to 2000 characters to keep the context of the LLM from being overwhelmed.
context_compaction.note: Also relies on previous_response_id server-side conversation; no summarization seen.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Since a response to a tool request has to be text (in particular, it cannot be an image), the actual contents of the files are appended to a separate message.
observation_format.note: view_images returns images (plots), coded as screenshots (closest value).

tool_count.evidence_quote: Using thesubmit_numeric_valuestool, the agent can submit answers to user-defined questions that can be answered with numbers.
tool_count.note: Researcher tools per Fig.1: handoff_to_coder, execute_python, view_images, view_text_files, 5 task tools, logic_review, write_final_report, end_project, submit_numeric_values (13 when numeric questions given; +get_feedback = 14 when allowed).

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: Thewrite_pythontool allows the coder to directly write code to a file.

protocol_standardization.note: File tree shows only custom tools, no mcp/a2a files.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: while not messages == [] and not self.stop:
loop_primitives.note: Coder lint+code review repair loop; optional get_feedback loop.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: It can assign itself new tasks withadd_task, select one from the list of open tasks withselect_taskand then complete and report on the selected task withcomplete_task.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: The main agent is the Researcher, which orchestrates the project. It can communicate with the Coder and the Logic reviewer through the use of tools.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Each logic review starts with freshly initialized logic reviewer with a clean context.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: After the initial prompt has been submitted by the user, the agents work autonomously and have no option to interact with the user.
human_in_loop.note: Outside container, user is prompted to execute code manually.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: the tools get_task_listandget_task_infoallow the researcher to get an overview of all tasks

long_term_memory.note: Only 2 code files in evidence; no config surface to check.

state_persistence.note: Run entry point not in evidence.

self_verification.evidence_quote: The code is automatically linted, that is, checked for syntax and style errors. If there are no such errors, it is passed on to the code reviewer agent.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: It is prompted once at the beginning with a task and is then left running until it either finishes its task or reaches a maximum number of calls set by the user.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: The process continues until it is either terminated by a specific tool or the total number of calls exceeds a limit.

cost_controls.note: Only automatic provider caching mentioned; no config surface in evidence.

timeouts.note: App. B mentions 'exceeding the maximum runtime' but mechanism not shown.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: For safely running AI-generated code it uses [this](https://github.com/olgarius/ai_agent) Singularity container.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: the Singularity container limits the directories in which the agent can work

tracing.evidence_quote: These provide detailed tool usage stats, success/failure rates, prompt context, model info, execution time, and more.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: If an evaluation file is provided, ROC and SIC Curves will be saved under `background_rejection_curve.png` and `sic_curve.png` respectively.
